the_measurement_that_settled_it.unmatched_negation_shape: 28 distinct surface forms over 45 occurrences across 41 criteria. Maximum repeat 4. The most common form, 'without locking', is not a token prohibition at all but a condition on behaviour — as are 'without affecting', 'without disrupting', 'without causing', 'without errors', 'without downtime'. Term overlap is a defensible test for those.
the_measurement_that_settled_it.invertible_population: Of the 41, only 4 carry a quoted token list. Of those 4, exactly ONE is a genuine prohibition. One genuine invertible prohibition in 597 distinct criteria — 0.17%.
the_other_three: 'No claim about a named competitor appears without a legal review annotation (e.g., \'Pending legal review\') next to it.' — the quoted token MUST BE PRESENT.
'The index is defined as a single-column index (only the \'timestamp\' column) without additional included columns…' — 'timestamp' must be present.
'…executed without causing table locks or downtime (CrateDB\'s default non-blocking behavior).' — the only quote character is a possessive apostrophe.
the_measurement_that_settled_it.conclusion: Broadening the marker would chase a 0.17% population while increasing the number of criteria that reach an inversion which is wrong for three cases in four.
